question: How do the management and the crop of a site-year show in the annual carbon balance (annual GPP against annual Reco) and in the share of days with net uptake?

reference.name: Hyytiälä
reference.source: SMEAR II Hyytiälä (station 2), SMEAR API, downloaded 2026-10-27 (data/smear/hyytiala/README.md): HYY_EDDY233.NEE and HYY_EDDY233.GPP, HYY_EDDYMAST.F_c_270
reference.signConvention: NEE gap-filled, positive = emission; GPP positive = uptake; Reco = NEE + GPP (umol CO2 m-2 s-1)
reference.timeBase: local time UTC+2 all year; the stamp is the start of the half hour (first stamp 1 January 00:00, last 31 December 23:30); local day = calendar day
reference.measuredFractionProxy: share of half hours with a measured HYY_EDDYMAST.F_c_270 value (NaN or empty = missing); longest gap = longest run without it

method.peakRule: 90 consecutive local days inside the calendar year (no crossing of the year end); score = sum of daily gpp_gc over the window days with a value; valid when 80 or more days have GPP; largest score wins, a tie goes to the earliest start; share = uptake days / days with daily NEE in the window; null when no window is valid
reasons: no annual GPP or Reco sum
method.failedGrassNote: Haltiala 2023 (grass sown, failed) is in the group grassland with the crop label 'grass (failed)'

rules: Sites: Anttila, Sarkisuo, Haltiala, Qvidja, Viikki and Maktau (order of db/sites.parquet;
the order gives the colour and the marker). A site-year is one site and one calendar year in
local time (the years of data/calculated/annual.csv).
1. Inclusion (the same rule in both figures): full_year and reliable are true in annual.csv.
reliable = measured fraction >= 0.2 and longest gap <= 30 days (docs/calculated.md); the
script checks that the flag agrees with these two limits. Figure 1 also needs an annual
GPP and Reco sum (a sum is NULL when one half hour of the year has no value). The script
derives the reason of each excluded site-year from the flags, in this order: "no flux
data" (measured fraction 0); else each failed flag: "partial year", "measured fraction <
0.2", "longest gap > 30 d"; else (Figure 1 only) "no annual GPP or Reco sum".
2. Annual sums (g C m-2 yr-1) from annual.csv: GPP, Reco and NEE (gap-filled NEE, nee_f_gc).
Reco/GPP = Reco / GPP. The script checks that each annual sum equals the sum of the daily
values of data/calculated/daily.parquet over the local days of the year (relative
difference <= 1e-6), and that a NULL annual sum has a daily gap.
3. Uptake day = a local day with daily NEE (nee_f_gc) < 0. Share = uptake days / days with a
daily NEE value, for the whole year and for June to August (JJA, calendar months 6 to 8 in
local time, also at Maktau, where JJA is not the main growing season).
3b. Peak-GPP window (Figure 3): 90 consecutive local days inside the calendar year of the
site-year (the window does not cross the year end). Score = sum of the daily GPP (gpp_gc)
over the days of the window with a value. A window is valid only when 80 or more of its 90
days have a GPP value (PEAK_MIN_GPP_DAYS); the valid window with the largest score wins,
and a tie goes to the earliest start. Share = uptake days / days with a daily NEE value in
the window. Also stored: start and end date, GPP sum, GPP days, NEE days and the mean
frac_measured of the window days. Without a valid window the value is null and Figure 3
shows the whole-year bar only.
4. Land use (CROPS, typed from the project notes in CLAUDE.md): group "grassland" or "annual
crop". Haltiala 2023 (sown grass that failed) has the crop label "grass (failed)" and is in
the group grassland. Events per site-year: the count per type of db/events.parquet in the
calendar year of the event date.
5. OLS line Reco = slope x GPP + intercept over the Figure 1 site-years (numpy.polyfit, degree
1), with Pearson r and n; the same without Maktau. Descriptive only, n is small.
6. Group summaries (grassland, annual crop): n, mean, SD (n - 1), min and max of NEE and
Reco/GPP over the Figure 1 site-years, and of the uptake shares over the Figure 2
site-years (whole year, June to August, peak-GPP window). A third summary gives the annual crops without Maktau (Finnish crops only).
7. Each step that removes rows logs a count (results.json dataVersion.steps).
8. Reference site SMEAR II Hyytiala (boreal Scots pine forest, rare management; Figures 4 and
5): files of the SMEAR API in --smear (data/smear/hyytiala/README.md), 2020 to 2025.
HYY_EDDY233.NEE (gap-filled, positive = emission) and HYY_EDDY233.GPP (positive) in
umol CO2 m-2 s-1, Reco = NEE + GPP. The time stamps are local time (UTC+2 all year) and
mark the start of the half hour (the first stamp of a file is 1 January 00:00, the last
31 December 23:30). Daily sums use the same factor as the other sites (1800 s x 12.011e-6
g C umol-1). A daily or annual sum is NULL when a half hour has no value. The measured
fraction comes from HYY_EDDYMAST.F_c_270 (measured CO2 flux at 27 m; "NaN" or empty =
missing): daily = measured half hours / 48, annual = measured half hours / all half
hours; longest gap = the longest run of half hours without a measured value, in days.
full year = all days of the year have 48 half hours; reliable = the rule of step 1. The
inclusion rule, the uptake shares and the peak window are the same as for the other
sites. Hyytiala is not in the groups grassland and annual crop; it is the group forest.
It has no events. The stand was thinned at the start of 2020 (40 % of the basal area
removed; de Quesada et al. 2025, LITERATURE); Figure 4 marks 2020 with "(thinning)".
9. Open findings of docs/anomaly-data-report.md that touch this dive are printed
(OPEN_FINDINGS).
10. LITERATURE: the facts of the Hyytiala thinning from de Quesada et al. 2025 (reference id
dequesada2025), with page, table or figure. They go to results.json (literature,
literatureByKey) and into the text of Figure 4.
openFindings: ANT-01, SAR-01, VII-01 (open, waits for the providers): the raw stamps of Anttila, Sarkisuo and Viikki are UTC, but the build reads them as UTC+2. A local day of these sites thus holds the hours 02:00 to 02:00 true local time. The annual sums change by the 2 hours at the ends of the year only; a daily NEE near 0 can change its sign, so the uptake-day share can change a little.

QVI-11 (open question): the Qvidja annual NEE of the file is 40 to 110 g C m-2 more negative than Heimsch 2024 Table 1 (May-to-May years). The Qvidja markers can thus sit a little too far below the 1:1 line.
VII-05 (open): Viikki 2024 nee_f is not equal to nee in 1 540 periods. The daily NEE of Viikki 2024 can thus differ from the measured values.
method.literature: none: the script uses no literature value

figures.title: Annual total ecosystem respiration (TER, = Reco) against annual gross primary production (GPP), one marker per site-year; below the 1:1 line the site-year was a net CO2 sink.
figures.desc: Scatter plot of 15 site-years (full and reliable years with annual GPP and TER): x axis annual GPP (g C m−2 yr−1), y axis annual total ecosystem respiration (TER, = Reco; g C m−2 yr−1), both from 400 to 1600 on the same scale. A dotted 1:1 line divides net source years (above, NEE > 0) from net sink years (below, NEE < 0); light dotted lines mark NEE = −200 and −400 g C m−2 yr−1; faint grid lines every 200. Annual GPP is 660 to 1479, TER 612 to 1465 g C m−2 yr−1. 9 site-years are below the line and 6 above it. NEE is −73 ± 155 (mean ± SD, range −392 to 131, n = 15) g C m−2 yr−1; the strongest sink is Maktau 2019 maize with NEE −392, the strongest source Haltiala 2023 grass (failed) with NEE 131. OLS line: TER = 0.67 × GPP + 262, r = 0.75 (n = 15); without Maktau slope 0.66, r = 0.84 (n = 14). Each site has its own colour and marker; labels give the year and, for annual crops and the failed grass, the crop.

figures.title: Share of days with net CO2 uptake (daily NEE < 0) per site-year, over the whole year and over June to August.
figures.desc: Grouped bar chart of 16 site-years (full and reliable years), grouped by site. Per site-year, the left bar (full site colour) is the share of days with daily NEE < 0 over the whole year, the right bar (lighter, hatched) the share over June to August; y axis days with net CO2 uptake, NEE < 0 (%), 0 to 100, faint guide lines at 25, 50, 75 and 100 % (the 50 % line dotted and a little stronger). At the Finnish sites the share is 18 % to 37 % of the year (n = 15) and 55 % to 91 % of June to August; Maktau 2019: 87 % and 99 %. Mean ± SD (range) of the whole year: grassland 31 % ± 4 % (25 % to 37 %, n = 11), annual crops 36 % ± 29 % (18 % to 87 %, n = 5); of June to August: grassland 70 % ± 11 % (55 % to 91 %, n = 11), annual crops 77 % ± 15 % (62 % to 99 %, n = 5). Whole year and June to August per site-year: Anttila 2022: 36 % and 78 %; Anttila 2023: 36 % and 71 %; Särkisuo 2022: 29 % and 72 %; Särkisuo 2023: 31 % and 66 %; Haltiala 2022 oats: 24 % and 62 %; Haltiala 2023 grass (failed): 25 % and 60 %; Haltiala 2024 sunflower: 24 % and 73 %; Haltiala 2025 oats: 18 % and 67 %; Qvidja 2020: 37 % and 78 %; Qvidja 2022: 29 % and 73 %; Qvidja 2023: 27 % and 57 %; Qvidja 2024: 32 % and 72 %; Qvidja 2025: 28 % and 55 %; Viikki 2024: 36 % and 91 %; Viikki 2025 faba bean: 27 % and 84 %; Maktau 2019 maize: 87 % and 99 %.

figures.title: Share of days with net CO2 uptake (daily NEE < 0) per site-year, over the whole year and over the 90-day window with the largest GPP sum of the year.

events.rule: all events; counted per site, calendar year of the event date and type

annual.rule: one row per site and local calendar year; the reliable flag agrees with frac_measured >= 0.2 and longest_gap_days <= 30

daily.rule: one row per site and local day; a day without daily NEE is not counted in the uptake share

hyytiala.rule: no row is removed; a half hour without NEE or GPP makes the daily and annual sum NULL; NaN or empty F_c_270 = not measured

sumCheck.rule: annual sum = sum of the daily values of the local year; a NULL annual sum has a daily gap

inclusion.rule: full_year and reliable; Figure 1 also needs annual GPP and Reco
